# Week 8 Start/Sit Briefing -- Monday, 2026-10-26

**Pivoting to Week 8.** Week 7 is effectively closed for this roster -- 13 of 14 games final, and the one game still to play tonight (DAL@PHI) involves neither of this roster's teams. `season_week.load_current_week_nflreadpy(2026)` still reports Week 7 for exactly that reason, but following the same convention as the 10/19 and 10/05 Monday briefings, this report moves ahead to Week 8.

## Source and freshness -- READ THIS FIRST

The committed Week 8 fixture (`weekly-report-week-8.json`) is a **pre-season placeholder dated 2026-09-08** -- it predates the season and is unusable. This briefing instead comes from a live run of `generate_report.py` executed directly in this sandbox against real `nflreadpy` data, with three degradations versus a normal week:

1. **Zero injury designations.** ESPN's injury API and Sleeper are both proxy-blocked here (403s), and live `nflreadpy.load_injuries(2026)` returned 0 rows for Week 8 -- no team has filed yet, which is expected five days before the first Week 8 game (Thu 10/29, CAR@GB). Every player defaulted to "Healthy." Re-check Wednesday.
2. **No FantasyPros consensus tier.** No API key in this sandbox, so every player -- including Jaxon Smith-Njigba -- runs on the in-house model only this week, not blended with vendor consensus.
3. **No Rotowire data** (also proxy-blocked) -- no red-zone/target-share color this week.

Tuesday's scheduled CI run has real access to all of the above and will likely supersede this with a proper fixture -- treat this briefing as a bridge, not the final word, once that lands.

## Start these ten -- 130.52 expected points (see note on the kicker gap)

| Slot | Player | Opp | Expected | P(play) | If he plays |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| QB | Matthew Stafford | vs LAC | **16.56** | 97.2% | 17.05 |
| RB | Jonathan Taylor | vs JAX | **16.52** | 95.4% | 17.31 |
| RB | Bucky Irving | vs ATL | **15.48** | 95.4% | 16.21 |
| WR | Jaxon Smith-Njigba | @CHI | **22.34** | 96.9% | 23.04 |
| WR | Drake London | @TB | **15.81** | 96.9% | 16.30 |
| TE | Sam LaPorta | @MIN | **10.28** | 94.7% | 10.86 |
| FLEX | Tee Higgins | vs TEN | **14.96** | 96.8% | 15.46 |
| FLEX | Jameson Williams | @MIN | **11.45** | 96.8% | 11.84 |
| K | *(none rostered)* | -- | **0.00** | -- | -- |
| DEF | Jets D/ST | @LV | **7.12** | 100% | 7.12 |

**The kicker slot is empty.** Dominic Zvada, the only rostered K, is on NYG's Week 8 bye, and there is no bench kicker. The 130.52 total is low purely because of this zero -- with any replacement-level kicker (roughly 7-8 points), the real total is ~138, squarely in this roster's normal range. This is a roster gap, not a model problem.

Bench, non-bye: Bo Nix (QB, 14.79 exp, clean hold behind Stafford), Jalen Coker (WR, 11.33 exp, lost the second FLEX spot to Williams by a razor-thin 0.12).

On bye this week (NYG/NO), not playable regardless of projection: Tyler Shough (QB), Cam Skattebo (RB), Isaiah Likely (TE).

## Changes since Saturday's briefing (10/24, Week 7, 141.52)

1. **Pivoted Week 7 -> Week 8.**
2. **K: Dominic Zvada -> empty (-7.91).** His own bye, flagged in both the 10/21 and 10/24 briefings with no claim made in time. This is the single biggest driver of this week's lower total.
3. **FLEX: Jalen Coker -> Jameson Williams (+0.12).** With no FantasyPros tier active this run, every WR runs on the same in-house number, and Williams edges Coker by a hair. Thin enough to flip on Wednesday's refresh -- don't treat it as settled.

## Watch list

- **Jameson Williams vs. Jalen Coker at FLEX** -- 0.12 points apart, inside model noise. Recheck when Tuesday's real fixture or Wednesday's practice report lands.
- **The kicker slot itself** -- not an injury question, a roster gap. Needs action, not watching, before Wednesday's deadline.

## Opponent notes

- Jaxon Smith-Njigba's road trip to Chicago is this week's highest-upside play by seven points over the next-best player (22.34 expected).
- Bo Nix (bench) trails Stafford by a clean 1.77 points this week with no stale-consensus distortion (unlike the last two weeks) -- straightforward hold.

## ACTION NEEDED: claim a kicker before Wednesday

This run's waiver scan surfaced three options, all healthy and all playing Week 8: **Wil Lutz** (DEN, 7.91 expected, vs KC -- top pick on projection, but note DEN is on its own bye in Week 10, which reopens this same hole two weeks later), **Jason Sanders** (NYJ, 7.84, @LV), and **Drew Stevens** (WAS, 7.75, vs PHI, byes Week 12 -- the safer long-term hold). Also surfaced, not needed right now: Rachaad White (RB, WAS, 8.65 expected) as a depth option if an RB need ever opens up.

## Byes ahead

- **Week 8 (now):** Zvada (K), Shough (QB), Skattebo (RB), Likely (TE) -- all NYG/NO, already reflected above.
- **Week 9:** Matthew Stafford (QB, Rams' bye) -- this roster's only QB besides bench Bo Nix. Plan to either start Nix that week or stream a QB.
- **Week 10:** Bucky Irving (RB, Buccaneers' bye) and bench Bo Nix (Broncos' bye) -- Irving is this roster's RB1 alongside Taylor, so this is a real one to plan for, not just a bench note.
